Select IC50 activity rows for JAK2 with compound provenance and target details. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then to docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Include compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50' and target_dictionary.pref_name = 'JAK2'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
